_about: Ground truth for PDF intake (B1 acceptance: >=9/10 titles, every DOI present found, >=80% of listed sections detected, the scanned PDF flagged needs_ocr). 'doi_in_pdf' is the work's own DOI as printed in the first 2 pages (null = not printed, so extraction must return null or the enriched DOI later); 'doi' is the true DOI for OpenAlex/Crossref enrichment (B2). 'sections' lists the headings a correct detector should find (kind, heading text, 1-based page_start). Titles compare after normalising whitespace and quotes. Licences and sources: README.md.
